synth.notes:
One horizontal mirror axis (wall row of 3x3 blocks) plus 3x3-block pieces. A5 cycles axis -> pieces -> axis; A1/A2 move the selection up/down one block; A3/A4 move a piece sideways (the axis ignores them).
The step-71 mechanic: the axis is not blocked by piece rows. It passes under pieces, which can sit on the axis row, and only bounds and piece overlap block a move.
Reflection block = (2A-R, C), with none on the axis row. Render order is wall<target<reflection<piece. Holes show the solid below (a selected wall dot is solid 0, owned by the piece above it); otherwise they show their own fill. The frame is then re-extracted.
Names: wall/piece = rank among 4-connected components of own cells plus all 0 cells; reflections/targets ranked by bbox (x,y). Selection comes from the 0s in walls first, then from pieces.
Passes 30/30 with hidden state and 30/30 stateless. Unconfirmed: A5 order past the observed cases, and whether reflections exist under pieces (that makes no visible difference).
